keys.title: AI API keys
keys.description: Global keys for every AI provider supported. Workspaces on plans without "Bring your own key" use these as the fallback. Encrypted at rest.
keys.superOnly: Only a super admin can manage the platform's AI keys.

card.unreadable: Saved key cannot be read, paste it again
card.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
card.maxTokensHint: Optional ceiling — a single AI request can never burn more than this many output tokens. Leave blank for the model default.
card.extraModelsHint: Optional. Model ids to offer next to the default, separated by commas.
card.removeBody: Workspaces will stop using {name} until you add a key again. The provider is turned off.

help.title: Fallback chain
help.body: When a workspace runs an AI feature, AiKeyResolver tries the workspace's own key first (only available on plans with BYOK enabled). If none is set, it falls back to the matching Active row here. Disabling a provider above means workspaces on non-BYOK plans simply can't use it.

dashboard.title: AI usage & token burn
dashboard.description: Every AI call across the platform — which provider, which model, which workspace, on platform keys vs their own (BYOK) keys, with an estimated spend.
dashboard.dailyEmpty: No AI calls recorded in this window yet.
dashboard.splitNote: Only platform-key tokens count against a plan's monthly AI cap. BYOK workspaces spend on their own provider account.

usage.title: AI Usage
usage.description: Every AI call your workspace made — tokens burnt, by model and provider, plan keys vs your own keys, and an estimated cost.

kpis.calls: {count, plural, one {# AI call} other {# AI calls}}

cap.title: This month · plan AI cap
cap.used: {used, number} of {limit, number} tokens used this month
cap.unlimited: {used, number} tokens used this month: unlimited on your plan
cap.reached: Almost at your monthly cap. Upgrade your plan or add your own keys (BYOK) to keep using AI.
cap.note: BYOK tokens run on your own provider account and never count against your plan cap.

usage.empty: No AI usage in this window yet.
usage.costNote: Cost is an estimate based on published blended per-provider token rates and may differ from your provider invoice. Token counts are exact.

own.title: Your AI provider keys
own.description: Add your own key for a vendor so your AI features use your account instead of the shared one. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.
own.allowed: Your plan lets your own keys take precedence.
own.notAllowed: Your plan does not include your own keys yet. You can save them now, but calls will keep using the shared key until you upgrade.
own.removeBody: Calls fall back to the shared key if one is available.
own.empty: You have not added any keys.
